why_ai: Licensed agents and escrow officers hold funds and sign policies as underwriters' agents, but search, exam and document work is screen-based and automating.
why_clarity: Clear title, a balanced Closing Disclosure and an on-time closing are checkable outcomes, though claims surface years later.
why_digital: Recorded documents and production systems on screen, with closings, funds and referrals still local.

why_ai: Agents choose the title company on the escrow officer's relationship and reliability, while curative tracking automates.
why_clarity: Clear-to-close by the contract date is an exact target repeated on every file.
why_digital: Documents and email drive the file, but signings, funds and agent referrals are local.

why_ai: Large liability, bespoke exception and endorsement negotiation with lender's counsel, and repeat-counsel relationships protect it.
why_clarity: Each deal's exceptions, survey and endorsements differ, and success is a negotiated pro forma.
why_digital: Recorded instruments, surveys and redlines on screen, coordinated across states.

why_ai: Searching unindexed books means physical presence at the courthouse and local knowledge of its records.
why_clarity: A complete search is defined, but misses show up only when a claim appears.
why_digital: Paper books and microfilm in the county building, with a digital report delivered.

why_ai: Requesting payoffs and tracking releases is counterparty chasing that agents and software can do.
why_clarity: Each lien is paid and released or it is not, with statutory deadlines.
why_digital: Payoff statements, recordings and index checks are all document work.

why_ai: Routing requests and reading payoff statements is a direct document-automation task.
why_clarity: The payoff figure is exact and checked against the final servicer number after funding.
why_digital: Servicer portals, fax and statements, all handled on screen.

why_ai: Monitoring indexes, sending demands and assembling final policies is rule-driven tracking.
why_clarity: A satisfaction is recorded or not, against a statutory deadline.
why_digital: County e-records, letters and policies are digital.

why_ai: Every heirship file is a novel family history needing underwriter acceptance, attorney involvement and family trust.
why_clarity: Paths differ by state, family and underwriter, and each file is one-off and slow to resolve.
why_digital: Courthouse probate files, family interviews and signatures gathered in person across states.

why_ai: Owners sign for compliance personally, but evidence gathering and questionnaires are automatable.
why_clarity: Best Practices and audit checklists define the evidence, repeated each assessment.
why_digital: Bank feeds, production data and questionnaires are digital, sold to small local shops.

why_ai: Clean-chain search and commitment drafting is the target of underwriter AI now in production.
why_clarity: Standard commitments follow set formats across thousands of near-identical files.
why_digital: Plant and e-records in, commitments out, often produced remotely.

why_ai: Reconciling two statements under TRID rules is deterministic screen work.
why_clarity: The two documents agree to the cent or they do not, under codified rules.
why_digital: Both statements are system-generated documents exchanged online.

why_ai: Licence, insurance and trust-account checks are rule-based, though the pooled incident database is hard to copy.
why_clarity: Vetting follows a checklist across tens of thousands of similar agents.
why_digital: Records and verifications in, ratings delivered into lender systems.

why_ai: Calling municipalities and compiling balances is routine research that portals and agents are absorbing.
why_clarity: Each report lists open items against a fixed scope and is checked at closing.
why_digital: Municipal records gathered by phone and portal, reports delivered online nationally.

why_ai: Adversarial fraud and AI-enabled impersonation keep demand for loss-backed verification growing.
why_clarity: A verification passes or fails on each transaction, with fraud outcomes known quickly.
why_digital: Identity and bank data in, verifications out, sold remotely.

why_ai: Maintaining rate tables and returning quotes is a data task software already performs.
why_clarity: A quote is right or wrong against the final Closing Disclosure.
why_digital: Rate filings in, API quotes out.

why_ai: Switching costs protect the installed base, but the work is software built on screens.
why_clarity: Product features ship against defined requirements and are tested quickly.
why_digital: Fully digital product sold and supported remotely.

why_ai: Auditors visit agents and judge escrow and remittance risk for an accountable underwriter.
why_clarity: Audit programmes are codified and repeat across thousands of agents.
why_digital: Escrow records and registers reviewed largely on screen, with some on-site work.

why_ai: Pricing professional liability on thin claims data is judgement-heavy and accountable.
why_clarity: Underwriting follows guidelines, but losses emerge years later.
why_digital: Applications and loss runs in, policies out, through brokers.

why_ai: Acquisition judgement and owner relationships drive deals.
why_clarity: Each acquisition is bespoke and its outcome known years later.
why_digital: Financial and order data analysed on screen, deals done in person.

why_ai: Statutory authority to license, audit and set rates cannot be outsourced to software.
why_clarity: Licensing and audits follow statutes on near-identical filings.
why_digital: Filings and audits largely digital, bound to one state.

why_ai: Federal rulemaking and enforcement carry statutory authority and contested, high-stakes judgement.
why_clarity: Rules and enforcement are bespoke and litigated over years.
why_digital: Filings, complaints and rules are digital, under one federal jurisdiction.

why_ai: Remote production search and typing is exactly what AI search and drafting replace.
why_clarity: Per-file production against client templates repeats at volume.
why_digital: Fully remote digital production sold across borders.

why_ai: Three-way reconciliation is deterministic software work.
why_clarity: Accounts balance to the cent daily or they do not.
why_digital: Bank and ledger feeds in, alerts out.

why_ai: Advocacy and standard-setting depend on member trust and political judgement.
why_clarity: Advocacy outcomes are diffuse and slow to judge.
why_digital: Research and advocacy produced digitally, with in-person lobbying.

why_ai: Compiling public statutory filings into tables is automatable.
why_clarity: Market share tables are exact recomputations of filings.
why_digital: Public filings in, data products out.

why_ai: Courts admit a named expert's opinion and cross-examine the person.
why_clarity: Each case is novel and resolved by a court long after the report.
why_digital: Case files reviewed on screen; testimony in person.

why_ai: Owners sell their life's work through a trusted advisor.
why_clarity: Each sale is bespoke and its success judged long after closing.
why_digital: Financials analysed digitally, relationships built in person.

why_ai: A CPA or assessor signs the attestation and carries the liability.
why_clarity: The framework defines tests repeated agency by agency.
why_digital: Evidence reviewed remotely, with some on-site testing.
